lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Boston businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Boston is a compact, expensive and highly educated city where hospitals, universities, biotech and finance set the pace and a large student population turns over every year. We help companies here compete in a crowded market by being specific about who they serve and where.

sections.heading: Compact city, distinct neighbourhoods
paragraphs: Boston is small in area and dense, and each neighbourhood has its own character and customers. Back Bay and Newbury Street mean retail and offices. Beacon Hill and the South End are residential and affluent, with independent shops and restaurants. The North End is known for its restaurants and bakeries, the Seaport for new offices, hotels and apartments, and Fenway for the ballpark, nightlife and nearby campuses.

Further out, Dorchester, Jamaica Plain, South Boston, Roxbury, Charlestown, East Boston and Allston-Brighton are large neighbourhoods with their own main streets. Then come the neighbouring cities that work as part of the same market: Cambridge and Somerville across the river, Brookline, Newton and Quincy. Many residents get around by subway, bus or on foot, so being close to a station can matter more than having parking, and people look for businesses within a short walk or ride.

sections.heading: September, graduation and the marathon
paragraphs: The academic calendar shapes local demand to an unusual degree. A large share of the city's apartment leases begin on the first of September, and the weeks around it are the peak of the year for movers, storage, furniture, internet installation, cleaners and estate agents. New students and their families also choose banks, gyms, salons and places to eat in those first weeks.

Spring has graduation weekends, when hotels and restaurants fill early, and the Boston Marathon in April. Red Sox home games change foot traffic around Fenway for half the year. Winter storms can close things at short notice and create urgent demand for heating and snow services.
bullets: Campaigns for the move-in season prepared and running well before late summer.
Reservation and event pages published early for graduation weekends.
Business profile hours updated promptly during storms and holidays.

sections.heading: Medicine, research and finance
paragraphs: The Longwood Medical Area and the hospitals near Beacon Hill and the South End make Boston one of the world's great medical cities, and Kendall Square in neighbouring Cambridge is a centre of the biotechnology industry. Around them are laboratory suppliers, contract research firms, software companies, consultants and medical practices of every kind. The Financial District and Back Bay house asset managers, banks, insurers and law firms.

These audiences expect substance. Marketing to them works when the website explains exactly what you do, the content is written by or with people who know the field, and campaigns are aimed at defined roles. For medical practices, patient reviews, provider profiles and compliant ad wording carry the most weight.

sections.heading: Standing out where everyone advertises
paragraphs: Boston has many agencies, many funded startups and many established firms bidding on the same searches, so broad keywords are costly. We look for the narrower terms that describe your real strengths, the neighbourhoods where you can win map results, and the creative that makes an ad look like it belongs here.

faqs.a: No. We work with Boston businesses remotely, by video call and shared reporting.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to hire a digital marketing agency in Boston?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of work, the channels and how competitive your field is. We provide a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How can a small business compete with bigger advertisers in Boston?
faqs.a: By narrowing the target. Focus on specific services, specific neighbourhoods and the questions your customers actually ask, keep your business profile and reviews strong, and spend on the searches where you can win.

faqs.q: When should I advertise to students moving to Boston?
faqs.a: Start before late summer, when leases turn over and new students arrive, and have pages and listings ready earlier, since families research in advance. The exact schedule is agreed in the plan.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in Cambridge, Somerville and Brookline?
faqs.a: Yes. They are part of the same market but are searched by their own names, so we build pages, profiles and targeting for each place you serve.
